cover.caption: Gjertrudsfuglen er der ute ennå.
cover.alt: En svart fugl med rød topp hakker i en telefonstolpe ved veien. Under står den lille, røde lefsebua, og tunge regnskyer kommer inn over granskogen.
cover.prompt: The Red-Capped Bird clings to a weathered wooden telephone pole beside an empty county road and pecks at the wood, her scarlet crest bright against heavy grey rain clouds rolling in over the dark spruce. Below her stands the small red lefse shack with its bench and gravel lay-by, and the first fat raindrops are darkening the dusty gravel.

Create the cover illustration for an illustrated book of modern fairy tales, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: The Red-Capped Bird clings to a weathered wooden telephone pole beside an empty county road and pecks at the wood, her scarlet crest bright against heavy grey rain clouds rolling in over the dark spruce. Below her stands the small red lefse shack with its bench and gravel lay-by, and the first fat raindrops are darkening the dusty gravel.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Red-Capped Bird: A black woodpecker, sooty black all over from beak to tail, its feathers a little ruffled and greasy with soot, and on top of its head a bright-scarlet crest that rises to a small pointed tuft at the back, exactly like a tiny knitted hat. It has a strong, pointed, pale ivory beak, round pale-yellow eyes with a sour, grumpy look, stiff black tail feathers for propping itself against poles and trunks, and grey clawed feet.

Story world: Present-day Norway in July. Gjertrud's lefse shack stands alone by a county road: a small, low wooden hut painted red, with one window, a bench outside and a gravel lay-by. Inside is one room with a glass-fronted counter, a big round electric griddle on a steel table, a floury worktop with a rolling pin, and a steel extractor hood above the griddle whose fan hums from opening to closing time; its duct runs up into the hut's old brick chimney, black with twenty-two years of grease and soot. The lefser are big, thin, round flatbreads, pale with brown speckles, and every one Gjertrud rolls, however tiny the scrap of dough, spreads until it covers the whole griddle.

This story's season, light and colours: A hot, still July afternoon: pale dusty gravel, bleached grass and tall purple lupins along the county road, a hazy white sky and dark spruce behind. Inside the shack: flat, cool daylight from the window, brushed steel, the orange glow of the griddle and pale flour. Accents: the scarlet knitted hat and the greasy black of old soot.

Art style: Contemporary Scandinavian editorial illustration: flat, graphic shapes with subtle risograph grain and a little hand-drawn texture, clean confident lines and a limited palette of spot inks led by deep petrol blue, with fjord teal, lingonberry red, honey mustard, sage green, warm paper off-white and ink charcoal, like the pages of a risograph-printed book, shifted towards each story's own season, light and colours, in the cool, clear Nordic light of today. Present-day Norway: fjord towns, suburbs, farms with tractors, cabins, ferries, roadside petrol stations, offices and flats, grey rain and bright snow, with people in modern clothes such as rain jackets, knitted sweaters, hoodies, suits and work wear. The magic of the tale appears plainly in this everyday world: trolls, talking animals and enchantments look real and slightly absurd, drawn in the same flat style. characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.description: Eier av et lite veikantkjøkken som baker lefser; hun sier ja med munnen, men holder igjen med hendene, og blir fanget av sin egen smålighet.
characters.look: A stout, square-built woman of about fifty-five with a square jaw, pinched thin lips, a sharp little upturned nose and small darting black eyes. Her iron-grey hair is tucked away under a tall, pointed, bright-scarlet knitted hat with a tassel, pulled down to her eyebrows. She wears a white short-sleeved work tunic, a flour-dusted white apron, dark-grey trousers and white clogs.

characters.name: Jesus
characters.description: En stille, sliten vandrer som ber høflig om en liten smakebit og svarer med hard rettferdighet når godhet nektes.
characters.look: A very old, tall and slightly stooped man with a long, gentle face, deep-set, kind blue-grey eyes, a high wrinkled forehead, thin snow-white hair to his shoulders and a long white beard that reaches his belt. He wears a long, plain, hooded brown cloak over a simple undyed tunic, both dusty to the knees, and worn leather sandals, and carries a tall, knobbly wooden staff. No halo.

characters.name: Peter
characters.description: Reisekameraten som følger etter, sulten og trøtt, og blir vitne til både mirakel og straff uten å styre utfallet.
characters.look: A short, sturdy, round-shouldered old man of about sixty-five with a round, cheerful face, a shiny bald head with a fringe of short grey hair around the back, big ears, a broad flat nose, bright brown eyes and a short, bristly grey beard. He wears a long, faded green hooded cloak over a knee-length belted tunic, dusty to the knees, and worn leather sandals, with a small bronze key on a cord at his belt. No halo.
